card.name: Right before an OR-starting word
card.fires_on: Words just before a word starting with "OR", such as ORSERDU, ORLYNVAH, "OR SERUM ALT" or "TENDON RUPTURE" in all-caps warnings. The pole is strongly negative here.

modes.label: Before OR-brand names
modes.description: Small linking words right before a drug name that begins with OR.
modes.example: use effective contraception during treatment<< with>> ORSERDU and for 1 week

modes.label: Boxed warning capitals
modes.description: Partway through capitalized warning terms, where the next piece is RUPTURE or OR.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS ADVERSE REACTIONS INCLUDING TENDINITIS, TEND<<ON>> RUPTURE, PERIPHERAL NE

modes.label: Before OR in lab lists
modes.description: A lab abbreviation right before the word OR in all caps.
modes.example: DISCONTINUED IF EITHER SERUM<< AST>> OR SERUM ALT LEVELS BECOME

card.writes: It pushes down OR and AND-type words as the next piece and slightly favors FILE, APP and ACT.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to start with OR, such as a brand name or the word OR in capitals.
